title: Rajasthan HC: A Request to Extend Voluntary Retirement Can't Be Ignored Before It Takes Effect
case_name: H.K. Meena v. State of Rajasthan & Anr.
citation: Special Appeal (Writ) No. 212/2017; 2026:RJ-JP:39247-DB; 2026 LiveLaw (Raj) 435, decided 3 October 2026
card_summary: Meena sought voluntary retirement from state service in 2013 on health grounds and, before his exit date took effect, asked for a further extension. The state rejected the request and retired him the next day. A Division Bench held the request could not be brushed aside merely because the pension rules say nothing about extensions, and upheld the single judge's order quashing his retirement.
card_tip: An employee who writes in before a voluntary retirement date takes effect, asking to extend or reconsider it, is owed a reasoned response even where the service rules are silent on extensions.
